claims.claim: Plugins are distribution containers bundling skills + agents + commands + MCP + hooks as atomic installable units; standalone skill is just a SKILL.md file without bundling.

Plugin namespace format: skill as plugin-name:skill-name (e.g., vercel:deploy), agent as @plugin-name:agent-name (e.g., @team-conventions:migration-agent), command as /plugin-name:cmd-name (e.g., /commit-commands:commit).
Plugin installation: /plugin install plugin-name@marketplace-name; follow with /reload-plugins to activate.

Three marketplace levels: (1) Official Anthropic marketplace (claude-plugins-official, auto-available), (2) Public third-party marketplaces (claudemarketplaces.com, skillsmp.com), (3) Custom self-hosted via extraKnownMarketplaces config.
claims.evidence: Official docs marketplace section + community catalog.

claims.claim: Custom marketplace sources accepted: GitHub repos, Git URLs, local paths, remote URLs.
Plugin updates via /plugin update plugin-name; pulls latest version from marketplace; plugin.json version field is source of truth (semver).

Major ecosystem marketplaces (April 2026): sickn33/antigravity-awesome-skills (33k+ stars, 1,410+ skills), travisvn/awesome-claude-skills (22k+ installs), VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills (1000+ skills), jeremylongshore (340 plugins + 1367 skills via CCPI package manager).
Plugin.json minimum schema: name, version (semver), description, author, license, repository; extended supports skills/agents/commands/mcp/hooks arrays + dependencies map.
claims.evidence: Community plugin examples + Anthropic official plugins.

claims.claim: Plugin dependencies (plugin.json dependencies.anthropic-code-tools) can gate minimum Claude Code version required; important for skills using 2.1+ features (merged commands+skills).

Premium skill DNA (common characteristics): vendor ownership (Remotion team owns Remotion skill), frontmatter discipline (trigger-rich description), multi-file resources (progressive disclosure full-stack), commitment-before-generation pattern, security audit.
Frontend Design (Anthropic official plugin): 277k+ installs; bans generic fonts (Inter, Roboto, Arial, Space Grotesk); forces commitment to specific aesthetic direction before code generation.
Remotion (vendor-maintained): 117k+ weekly installs; signed with Agent Trust Hub + Socket security audit; loads specialized rules for animations/timing/audio/captions/3D on demand.
Trail of Bits Security skills: CodeQL + Semgrep + variant analysis + structured audit methodologies; distributed via trailofbits/skills + trailofbits/skills-curated marketplace (community-vetted).

Standalone vs plugin trade-off: standalone is zero overhead (one file, no plugin.json, no marketplace) but lacks versioning, distribution, namespacing; plugin adds overhead but enables sharing at scale.

For Maciej's system (private use): standalone skills are optimal (35 skills + 42 commands in ~/.claude/ with zero plugin overhead); migration to plugin only beneficial if publishing as public distribution.
Bug #17283 affects plugin skills identically: namespace prefix does not shield plugin skill from fork-isolation bug when invoked via Skill tool.
claims.evidence: R2.C13 + R4.C9 cross-reference applied to plugin context.

claims.claim: Namespace scope priority UNKNOWN: whether plugin scope wins over project-level standalone with same base name is undocumented; community reports suggest local project wins but requires verification.
claims.evidence: Gap in official docs + community uncertainty.

claims.claim: Supply chain risk: official Anthropic marketplace presumed to have cryptographic signing (not publicly documented); third-party marketplaces lack signing; Trail of Bits skills-curated attempts community governance gap.
Fragmentation concern: 7+ competing awesome-lists + 3+ competing package managers (Anthropic, CCPI, sickn33 installer); ecosystem has not converged on canonical catalog.

Cross-agent compatibility trend: sickn33, VoltAgent, alirezarezvani write skill frontmatter compatible with Claude Code + Cursor + Codex CLI + Gemini CLI, positioning Claude Code format as de-facto standard.

conflicts_flagged.description: Namespace scope priority ambiguity (R6.C17): plugin vs project standalone with same base name. No authoritative doc; affects multi-source skill setups.
Ecosystem fragmentation: multiple package managers (Anthropic, CCPI, sickn33) with no interoperability; user confusion on canonical install path.

gaps_flagged.description: Plugin update mid-session behavior: does active conversation re-read updated skill, or state persists? Unclear.
Token cost impact of 1000+ installed plugin skills (sickn33 antigravity case): is listing budget exceeded? Descriptions truncated to useless length?
Marketplace signing/provenance: no public docs on Anthropic marketplace signing; security implications for enterprise adoption.
Plugin namespace in auto-invocation (path A): does Claude consider plugin-name:skill-name differently from plain skill-name in description matching?

summary: R6 systematizes plugin architecture (namespacing, marketplace, installation), catalogs top ecosystem repos (33k+ stars), identifies premium skill DNA (5 characteristics), and recommends standalone for Maciej's private use. Flags fragmentation and signing gaps.
